name: Oblique Crunch
steps: Lie on your side with legs stacked and knees slightly bent.
Place your top hand lightly behind your head.
Breathe out and lift your top shoulder toward your hip.
Hold for a second, lower slowly, then switch sides after the set.
cues: Lift the shoulder toward the hip

common_mistakes.mistake: Pulling the head with the hand
common_mistakes.fix: Keep the hand light; lift with the side muscles
Stay on your side with hips stacked
